rows.Kwic: 僧問：「大開爐煹，鋾鑄聖凡，末後重關，請師拈出。」師云：「但得雪消後，自然春到來。」

Override.AttributionNote: 大休珠禪師語錄, opening-of-retreat public exchange. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: he asks Daxiu Zhu to bring out the final heavy barrier, and Daxiu answers that when the snow melts spring naturally arrives. The six-rung review found no personal name for this monk.

rows.Kwic: 千個省發者不如一付法者，千個付法者不如一出世者。

Override.AttributionNote: 大休珠禪師語錄, general address on Dharma transmission. Daxiu Zhu is the exact speaker: he ranks a thousand students below one who awakens, a thousand awakened people below one entrusted with the Dharma, and a thousand such recipients below one who appears in the world to teach.
